lesson.subtitle: Lesson 9 -- What They Said
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Luiz Fernando da Silva | Lesson 9 -- What They Said

listenings.text: Luiz, Megan. I took a call from Rezende while you were out, and I want you to have it exactly. He said he would pay after the second harvest. He told me he was waiting for the co-operative. He claimed the last payment had already left his bank, and I could not verify that. He denied buying from another supplier this season. He asked for an extension to May and a copy of the statement. That is what he said. What I think is a different line, and I have not written it.

Luiz, Marco. About the note you are writing, keep two things apart. What he said goes above the line, and you can attribute every word of it. What you think goes below, on its own line, labelled as your view. I made this mistake for five years. I used to write the mood instead of the words. Somebody read my file eighteen months later and thought the customer had said it. Judgement is welcome in a file. It just has to be signed.
